control.title: Customer transaction alerts
control.description: Alert customers instantly for every debit, credit and sensitive account change, show the actual merchant name, mask account and card numbers, and apply a cooling period after mobile number or email changes.

implementation_notes: Implemented at Paisa Setu Fintech and reviewed annually.
evidence_hint: Sample alerts (masked), alert configuration, cooling period settings.
acceptance_criteria: Sample alerts for debits and account changes, with account or card numbers masked
Alerts show the merchant name and are sent for every transaction type in scope

requirements.title: Risk alerts, masked notifications and fraud flagging
requirements.guidance: Online alerts on failed transactions, velocity and geo-location; masked account and card details; merchant name (not the gateway) in messages with the OTP at the end; customers can flag fraud in the app or website.

requirements.title: Mobile app controls and 12-hour cooling period
requirements.guidance: Device binding and re-binding after long non-use, inactivity timeout, lockout after failed logins, block while remote-access apps run, and a 12-hour cooling period after a mobile number or email change.
